ABOUT ME

JM
Data Analyst

Building the Future
with Data & AI

I'm Jhansi Marasani, a B.Tech graduate in Computer Science Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) from Sree Vidyanikethan Engineering College, Tirupati. Currently working as a Software Analyst at VK Global Services.

My expertise spans machine learning, deep learning, data analysis, and visualization. I've worked on real-world projects ranging from medical image classification using deep neural networks to NLP-based spam detection — always focused on delivering measurable impact through AI.

I'm driven by curiosity, love exploring emerging trends, and thrive on solving complex data problems. Whether it's building predictive models or communicating insights through dashboards, I bring both analytical rigor and creative thinking.

2 PROJECTS
NLP · ML
SMS Spam Classification

Built an ML-powered spam detection system using NLP techniques. Performed tokenization, stop-word removal, and feature extraction. Implemented Multinomial Naive Bayes with precision/recall/F1 evaluation.

Python NLP Naive Bayes Scikit-learn NLTK
Deep Learning · Medical AI
Alzheimer's Classification

Undergraduate research on early Alzheimer's detection from brain MRI images using InceptionV3 with transfer learning. Compared VGG19, ResNet50, EfficientNet. Achieved high classification accuracy for medical diagnosis.
